dct_description_sm:
Mapping depicts Brampton Plan Schedule 2 TransCanada Pipeline linear alignments for pipeline infrastructure to make stakeholders aware of major infrastructure rights of way.

The TransCanada Pipeline is a major energy transmission corridor that traverses portions of the city and transports “natural gas” (a fuel composed of methane and hydrocarbons) across the region. Development adjacent to the pipeline is subject to safety, compatibility, and regulatory requirements to protect public safety and the long-term operation of the infrastructure.

This data is intended to be used in conjuction with other related mapping layers for this schedule, and may be impacted by other schedules, with consideration to the text of Brampton Plan.
